info.desc: Van Halen is the self-titled debut album by American hard rock band Van Halen, released in 1978. The album recorded in 1977 and released in February 1978. It has sold over ten million copies in the United States alone, one of the most successful debuts by a hard rock band. Along with 1984, it gives Van Halen two original (non-greatest hits) albums with Diamond status in sales. From a technical perspective, Eddie Van Halen's guitar solo, Eruption, was influential on many rock guitarists who found popularity in the 1980s."Eruption" was added to the album when producer, Ted Templeman heard Eddie .

podcast.body: Prior to its release, Eddie Van Halen expressed a positive feeling about this upcoming album during an interview in late 1978 or early 1979. He acknowledged that he simply wrote what he felt, and sometimes that resulted in "poppy sounding riffs," indicative of potential commercial success. "He said that he just kind of wrote what he felt and he could not help it if he came up with a quote poppy sounding riff."

podcast.body: The band released their debut album in 1978. "Van Halen was playing clubs and released their debut album in 1978."

This debut album, released in 1978, was a smash hit for Van Halen. It featured the number 84 single "Runnin' With the Devil" and became legendary for Eddie Van Halen's guitar pyrotechnics. "Runnin' With the Devil, a number 84 single from Van Halen's Smash, South titled 1978 debut album."

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album was released to critical disapproval, yet it achieved unexpected success among fans. Eddie Van Halen later admitted he had not anticipated its popularity. "That first album was called creatively Van Halen no surprise the critics did not like this band either but their fans did."
